scope: Independent read-only CPU review of completed benchmark records and retained cache/source bytes; no GPU rerun, source edit or queue change

recorded_runtime.producer: paired FP32, original Part1, FP16 q/r quantization, no autocast

pairs.independent_retained_bytes_checks: cache-file, q-array, r-array, packet, sealed-field-file, sealed-prediction-file, sealed-field-array, provider-manifest and provider-seal hashes all match benchmark records
cache-file, q-array, r-array, packet, sealed-field-file, sealed-prediction-file, sealed-field-array, provider-manifest and provider-seal hashes all match benchmark records

timing_scope.warmup: one real warmup per producer per pair
timing_scope.reported_speed_comparison: three uninstrumented alternating CUDA-synchronized calls per producer per pair
timing_scope.included: source setters/transforms, reference-mask resize, paired encoder, normalization/gate/projection, output conversion/transfer and cleanup; full comparator additionally runs actual Part2-4, binarization and native finalization
timing_scope.excluded: model/host setup, input file decode/cache/source reads, hash/parity comparisons, CPU lambda16 solve, fine-feature inference, sealing/writing/scoring and whole-cohort throughput
timing_scope.profile: one separate synchronized inclusive profile per producer per pair; nested measurements must not be summed or substituted for the uninstrumented repeats
timing_scope.uncertainty: two fixed reused pairs and three timing repeats per arm; not a representative runtime distribution or confidence interval

interpretation.verified_construction: prefix reconstructs the FP16 q/r cache faithfully for these two gate-on pairs; cached score/cov reproduce existing lambda16 outputs
interpretation.actual_prefix_outputs: q/r plus debiased flag, regenerated cov and target tensor; no response score or native mask
interpretation.lambda16_input_scope: benchmark uses independently sealed cov/score, not a prefix-produced score
interpretation.cold_query_limit: the existing RCG host score is the continuous FoRIS response after Part2-4; a cold query preserving that method must still generate that response. Skipping allPart2-4 is not a complete unchanged producer
interpretation.native_scope: actual full native was independently recomputed and matched stored native; prefix does not replace it with an expected mask
interpretation.limits: no gate-off case, no all1200/all4000 feature parity assertion, no full-method speedup, no lambda64/fine-feature efficacy result
